evidenceContract.userBehavior: Attempt to read the removed workspace-link location after the same Media Library has been explicitly bound.
canonicalPath: Project explicit Media Library recovery controls

observables.description: The removed neko/assets workspace path is rejected while the exact Conversation remains usable and reaches idle.

evidenceContract.expectedResult: Read rejects neko/assets/workspace/library-image.svg, no alternate Media Library locator is tried, and the Agent reports the explicit rejection marker.
evidenceContract.expectedFailure: A successful old-path read, a Media Library fallback Tool call, a global runtime error, or a missing terminal marker fails visibly.

steps.prompt: 调用 Read 一次且只读取 file_path=neko/assets/workspace/library-image.svg。该已退役工作区前缀应失败；失败后不要尝试其他路径、不要搜索、不要调用 ReadImage、Asset 或 shell 工具，只回复 RETIRED_WORKSPACE_PREFIX_REJECTED。
